results.rationale: Consistency: the tabletop perspective, table legs and multiple chair shapes/positions change; vase, books and white setting remain. Instruction: the foreground chair still projects well outside the table, with its seat exposed, so the requested tucked-under position is absent. Quality: coherent wooden furniture, plausible upholstery, natural surfaces and clean edges without noticeable artifacts.

Consistency: tray framing, can arrangement, labels and overall stack are substantially changed, including an added upper pack. Instruction: a matching loose can is on top, but another remains outside in front, so this duplicates rather than fully relocates the right can. Quality: many distorted letterforms, smeared labels and fused/ambiguous can boundaries in the upper pack are distracting structural and texture errors.
